script: You got up to grab a snack. That was your first mistake. The spot you were sitting in is now warm, and warm spots do not go to waste in this house, that's just basic thermodynamics. I have already claimed it, fully, with my entire body, and I will be looking directly at you when you come back to make sure you understand there is no negotiation happening here. You can sit somewhere else. There are other seats. This one is mine now, and honestly, a little bit was always going to be mine eventually. Dogs seeking out warmth this aggressively isn't random either, it's tied to real instincts around comfort and safety. The link's below.
hookText: That warm spot is mine now
